items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Like Benny Carter, I first met Benny Carter in Buffalo with Willie Bryant's band

ctx.x: Like Benny Carter, I first met Benny Carter in Buffalo with Willie Bryant's band, and he was playing second trumpet in the brass section, and he could outplay all the saxophone players in the band.
Yeah, and I mean he still blows good trumpet.
